entities.name: Kazuhide Uekusa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kazuhide Uekusa  is a Japanese economist, economic analyst, former senior economist at Nomura Research Institute, and chairman of the Three-Nations Research Institute. He was arrested for sexual offenses in 2004 and 2006.
